title: PARDUS SUPG2 SPORT current platform
notes: Current official Super Sport Gen2 platform page identifies HS-HPT carbon construction, a carbon fork, aero tube treatment, full internal routing, hidden seatpost clamp, UDH, BSA 68 and 700x40C maximum compatibility. It is a 105 build, so its component list and gallery image are platform-level evidence rather than an exact eGR configuration. The page gives no frame-only weight, exact fiber grade, lay-up schedule or measured stiffness result.
